messages:
Maya Singh: Heads up — planning SDK 3.5.0 cutover tonight 02:00 UTC. Quick async sync: who can own the deploy, smoke checks, and client comms? Key changes: default timeout reduced, and one small response schema rename (response.vec -> response.embedding). We added a server-side shim but want a careful rollout.
Jorge Alvarez: I can lead the deploy and monitor metrics. Will be on pager and standing by during the window.
Priya Patel: I’ll own client comms + release note copy. ETA for docs PR?
Maya Singh: Docs PR is open: https://git/repo/pull/789 — includes compat note and migration snippet. Need someone to sign off the example code.
Lukas Müller: I’ll run the smoke harness and perf quick checks. What are our canary buckets and cadence?
Maya Singh: Start 5% for 20m, then 25% if healthy. Canary buckets: sdk-canary-a, sdk-canary-b. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% or p95 latency +30% over baseline -> immediate rollback.
Jorge Alvarez: Noted. I’ll wire the alert thresholds into the deploy runbook and keep fallback route to model-v3-old ready.
deploy-bot: Canary initiated for 5% at 02:00 UTC — owner: Jorge Alvarez — metrics: https://observability/reports/sd k-3-5/canary-1
Priya Patel: Docs PR LGTM from my side. Migration snippet for the advisory: 
```bash
# old
response.vec
# new
response.embedding
```
Maya Singh: Good — add a short example showing both accessors and a note about telemetry. Also add a telemetry flag to detect clients still using the old key for 72h.
Lukas Müller: Smoke harness reports green for primary checks. Latency stable, token throughput unchanged, kv-cache hit rate same. One small flake in eu-west-1 regen tests — investigating but not blocking right now.
Jorge Alvarez: Thanks — proceeding to 25% at 02:25 UTC if no regressions. I’ll be online 02:00–03:30.
Maya Singh: Approved. Priya — can you post the in-product banner to #release-notices after 02:30 if canary is healthy?
Priya Patel: Yep — I’ll send the banner + customer advisory to the partners distribution list and update the changelog.
Lukas Müller: If the eu-west flake persists after 25% we should roll back to 0% and revert routing. Who’s the infra rollback contact? @eng-infra oncall?
Jorge Alvarez: Eng-infra oncall is Alex Chen (alexc). I’ve looped him in the incident channel and will page if needed.
Maya Singh: Final owners: smoke = Lukas, deploy/rollback = Jorge, client comms = Priya. Deploy window 02:00–03:00 UTC. Postmortem only if we hit rollback. Thanks everyone — :thumbsup:
